recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-angle portrait of a man in Western attire, characterized by warm, golden-hour lighting and a layered typographic treatment that combines distressed block lettering with neon-style script.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the cowboy hat creates a diagonal shadow across the upper face, focusing attention on the eyes and smile.
The texture of the shearling collar provides a soft, organic frame for the lower face and neck.
The typography is integrated into the lower right quadrant, overlapping the clothing to create depth.
Warm skin tones contrast against the cool blue and purple hues of the denim jacket.
coreInvariants: High-contrast warm lighting on the face
Layered, multi-style typography in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies 80% of the frame, tilted at a 30-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile, positioned in the upper-left and center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the tilt of the face down to the smile, then moves to the text cluster in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (skin, hat, fur)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones; high value contrast between the white text and dark clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy slab serifs and gestural script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a distressed, stencil-like block font with irregular edges.
Secondary text uses a thin, glowing neon-style script with rounded terminals.
Tertiary text uses a heavy, condensed slab serif with a slight shear.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the block font appear as if stamped onto individual white rectangles.
Script letters have a soft outer glow to simulate light.

treatment.fill: Dark ink on white distressed background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition of rigid, distressed industrial blocks with fluid, glowing organic script.

preserve: The tilted orientation of the text
The mix of three distinct styles
The white glow on the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the distressed block aesthetic of the primary name.
Provides the necessary hand-drawn, fluid contrast.
Basis for the heavy slab serif elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle, close-up portrait of a man with a goatee and cowboy hat, smiling. Lighting should be warm and golden, coming from the side. He is wearing a denim jacket with a thick shearling collar. The background is a soft, out-of-focus gradient of blue and tan.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three layers of text in the bottom right. Layer 1: Distressed block letters on white rectangular backgrounds. Layer 2: A large, white, glowing hand-written script tilted upwards. Layer 3: A bold, yellow slab-serif font tucked under the script.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting on the face warm and directional?
Does the typography overlap the clothing naturally?
Are there at least three distinct font styles present?
Is the composition tilted to create dynamic energy?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the block lettering
Angle of the subject's head tilt
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the clothing and fur

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text has a visible outer glow.
Ensure the block text looks like physical stamps or cutouts.
Verify the color balance between warm skin and cool denim.
Confirm the subject's eyes are sharp and well-lit.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned, tilted Western portrait with a three-tier typographic stack consisting of distressed blocks, glowing script, and heavy slabs.
